description: This file defines the SupabaseClient class, a wrapper around Supabase PostgREST endpoints providing methods for CRUD operations and different access modes (user, anonymous, admin). It facilitates communication with a Supabase backend, handling authentication headers, pagination, and HTTP requests using httpx.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A wrapper class for interacting with Supabase endpoints, supporting different authentication modes and standard CRUD operations.

methods.name: None __init__(self, token: Optional[str] = None, admin: bool = False)
methods.description: Initializes the SupabaseClient with appropriate URL, API key, and authorization headers based on the mode (user, admin, anon).

methods.name: "SupabaseClient" user_mode(cls, token: str)
methods.description: Creates a client instance with a user's JWT token to enable RLS-aware requests.

methods.name: "SupabaseClient" anon_mode(cls)
methods.description: Creates a client instance with anonymous/public access for public reads.

methods.name: "SupabaseClient" admin_mode(cls)
methods.description: Creates a client instance with admin privileges, bypassing RLS.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _headers(self)
methods.description: Generates the headers required for HTTP requests, including API key and authorization.

methods.name: httpx.Response get(self, path: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to the specified path with optional query parameters.

methods.name: httpx.Response post(self, path: str, json: Any)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to create resources, returning the created representation.

methods.name: httpx.Response patch(self, path: str, json: Any, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PATCH request to update resources, returning the updated representation.

methods.name: httpx.Response upsert(self, path: str, json: Any)
methods.description: Performs an upsert (update or insert) operation with conflict resolution, returning the representation.

methods.name: httpx.Response delete(self, path: str, params: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to remove resources.

methods.name: List[dict] list_paginated( self, table: str, select: str, limit: int = 1000, offset: int = 0, extra_filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, )
methods.description: Lists rows from a table with support for pagination, filtering, and custom select clauses.
